method: eth_call with stateDiff override of UniV2 pair slot 8 (reserve0|reserve1|blockTimestampLast) on https://robinhood.drpc.org
notes: r0 is the USDG reserve; the oracle reads r0/r1. A same-block swap resets tsLast so d=0 contributes 0 to the TWAP. Results confirm: the Diverged guard fires ONLY downward.
conclusion: No upward deviation guard exists. The upward ceiling is PREMIUM_CAP = 5x treasury floor (= 5.011x the current price). Downside dumps are refused (Diverged), which is a *pause*, not a cap.
